  • Classes in com.egradx.auth used by com.egradx.auth
    Class
    Description
    EgradxAuthorities.Definition
    One entry of the seeded catalog.
    EgradxAuthorityCatalog
    Every authority egradx-auth manages: its own (EgradxAuthorities) plus those contributed by other libraries (EgradxAuthorityContributor).
    EgradxAuthorityContributor
    Lets another library add its own authorities to egradx-auth's catalog — declared once, in code, rather than seeded by every application that uses it.
    EgradxDetailedException
    A refusal whose error envelope carries details, for a client to say more than the code alone.
    EgradxOrganizationProvisioningService
    Creating a usable organization in one transaction: the organization, the Admin role every organization is guaranteed to have, and the first user who can log in and administer it.
    EgradxOrganizationProvisioningService.Provisioned
    What EgradxOrganizationProvisioningService.provision(com.egradx.auth.dto.EgradxCreateOrganizationRequest) made: the organization and its first administrator's user id.
    EgradxOrganizationService
    Create/suspend/activate an organization — deliberately minimal.
    EgradxPlatformOrganization
    Answers "which organization is the platform organization?" — the one question the rest of the module needs in order to treat it as the head of the platform.
    EgradxRoleService
    Manages roles and their granular authorities, and assigns/revokes a user's role within a specific organization.
    EgradxUserService
    Administering the users inside one organization: who's a member, adding someone with a role, changing their details or role, deactivating them.
